title: Merge Intervals
statement: Given a list of intervals where each interval is [start, end] with start <= end, merge all overlapping intervals and return the resulting list of non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input. Two intervals overlap if they share at least one point (e.g. [1,3] and [3,5] overlap and should merge into [1,5]). Return the merged intervals sorted by start value ascending.
hints: Comparing every pair of intervals for overlap is O(n^2); sorting first makes a single linear pass sufficient.
Once sorted by start, an interval only needs to be compared against the last merged interval, since anything earlier is already resolved.

Sort by start. Keep a merged list; for each interval, if its start is <= the end of the last merged interval, extend that interval's end to the max of the two ends, otherwise append it as a new interval.
